svg.title: Stationary-state and minimum counts for two nonlinear coefficient sets and two truncations.
svg.desc: English: Stationary-state and minimum counts for two nonlinear coefficient sets and two truncations. 繁體中文：兩套非線性係數及兩種模態截斷的平衡態與極小值數目。

cc:Work.dc:description: Zero-phase signed stationary-state and strict-minimum counts on all 193 frozen load slices, comparing the separate ZIP (C=4, S=1) and prior-study (C=14000, S=42) coefficient sets at M=2 and M=4. Panel (c) explicitly subtracts prior from ZIP counts at matched loads; blue denotes M2 and green M4, with solid stationary-count and dashed minimum-count differences. Coincident sections in the upper panels therefore remain checkable rather than concealed. M=2 counts are complete only where the independent polynomial census is certified; its status is recorded for every plotted slice. M=4 counts are an incomplete empirical union of verified discoveries, not a completeness claim. Global sign partners are counted separately. Joining lines connect only frozen sampled loads and do not locate intervening bifurcations; counts do not certify complete connected-branch topology or physical stability.
